headline: Cisco Expressway RCE Flaw Actively Exploited
tldr: CISA added a critical Cisco Expressway RCE vulnerability to its KEV catalog after confirming active exploitation in the wild.
action: Apply the latest security updates from Cisco immediately.

headline: GL.iNet Cloud Remote Management Flaw Exploited
tldr: Hackers are actively exploiting a vulnerability in GL.iNet cloud remote management services to install custom malware, backdoors, and reverse shells on customer routers and KVM devices.
action: Disable cloud remote management on GL.iNet devices and check for unauthorized backdoors.

headline: Cleverbridge Data Breach Exposes Credit Card Numbers and CVVs
tldr: E-commerce platform Cleverbridge suffered a data breach exposing customer payment card information, including credit card numbers and CVV security codes.
action: Review statements for unauthorized transactions if you made purchases via Cleverbridge.

headline: OpenRouter Drops AI Providers Following Months of Prompt Theft
tldr: Attackers stole prompts and data from inside three AI inference providers for months, prompting OpenRouter to drop the providers.
action: Audit AI vendor data retention policies and review integrations with third-party inference providers.

headline: Ghostscript Sandbox-Escape RCE Vulnerability in File Processing Apps
tldr: A now-patched flaw in Ghostscript allows crafted files to escape the security sandbox and achieve remote code execution on servers processing PDFs and images.
action: Update Ghostscript to the latest patched version across all Linux servers handling user-uploaded documents.

headline: Rackspace Spot Cloud Platform Breach Exposes Kubernetes Secrets
tldr: Rackspace notified customers that compromised credentials led to a breach of its Rackspace Spot platform, enabling attackers to deploy unauthorized workloads and access Kubernetes secrets in customer clusters.
action: Audit Rackspace Spot environments, rotate compromised credentials, and check Kubernetes clusters for unauthorized workloads.

headline: Microsoft Entra Connect Health Flaw Exploited in Tenant Breach
tldr: Attackers exploited a vulnerability in Microsoft Entra Connect Health to gain unauthorized access to administrator email addresses and tenant configuration information.
action: Review Microsoft security advisories and audit Entra tenant configuration and access logs.

headline: FBI National Crime Information Center Database Breached
tldr: FBI systems containing the National Crime Information Center (NCIC) database used for law enforcement information sharing have reportedly been breached.

headline: MONAI Label Arbitrary File Write Zero-Day Exploited by AI Agents
tldr: China-linked threat actors used autonomous AI agents to discover and exploit a zero-day arbitrary file write vulnerability in MONAI Label 0.8.5 and earlier, gaining root access to a university server.
action: Upgrade MONAI Label beyond version 0.8.5 or restrict network access to the server.

headline: GnuPG GPGME Memory Bug CVE-2026-129975
tldr: A memory bug in GPGME versions prior to 2.3.0, triggered by a malicious OpenPGP key with a long user ID, could expose application data. Fixed versions have been released.
action: Upgrade GPGME to version 2.3.0 or later.

headline: SAP NetWeaver JNDI Data Query Logic Flaw
tldr: SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal contains an improper neutralization vulnerability in data query logic (CVE-2025-42884) allowing unauthenticated attackers to disclose or modify server information. Listed in CISA KEV.
action: Apply vendor mitigations and follow CISA BOD 26-04 guidance.

headline: N-able Server Breach Causes Global Mail Assure and SpamExperts Outage
tldr: Attackers breached an N-able server, causing a major worldwide service outage affecting Mail Assure and SpamExperts Hosted Cloud services.
action: Check N-able status updates and advisory guidance.

headline: Fabio Access-Control Bypass via Unnormalized Request Paths
tldr: go:github.com/fabiolb/fabio has an access-control bypass (CVE-2026-104099) where route selection uses raw unnormalized request paths, allowing unauthenticated attackers to bypass per-route ACL and basic-auth gates using dot-segments or encoded dots.
action: Update fabio to a version with normalized request path handling.

headline: Bell Canada Breach Exposes Enterprise Customer Data
tldr: Bell Canada confirmed a threat actor breached its systems and stole enterprise customer data, including circuit provisioning information.

headline: J.P. Morgan Chase Third-Party Data Breach
tldr: J.P. Morgan Chase suffered a data breach following a cyberattack at a third-party service provider that exposed customer personal information and marketing data.

headline: D-Link DCS-935L Local Recording CGI OS Command Injection
tldr: D-Link DCS-935L version 1.10.01 contains an OS command injection vulnerability (CVE-2026-133680) in the loginRouter function of web/cgi-bin/localrecording/setconf.cgi via manipulated account/password arguments. A public exploit is available.
action: Restrict access to vulnerable D-Link devices or replace end-of-life hardware.

headline: WhatsApp for Android Incomplete Ad-Reply URL Validation Flaw
tldr: WhatsApp for Android and WhatsApp Business for Android before 2.26.17.4 contain a vulnerability (CVE-2026-23871) involving incomplete validation of external ad-reply URLs, suspected of exploitation in scam campaigns.
action: Update WhatsApp for Android to version 2.26.17.4 or later.

headline: West Virginia Legislature Hit by Ongoing Cyber Incident
tldr: The West Virginia Legislature experienced an ongoing cybersecurity incident affecting IT systems without spreading to other government entities.

headline: The Container Store Restores Systems Following Cyberattack
tldr: The Container Store restored its website and systems following a cybersecurity incident.

headline: Bazuka Android Malware Framework Disclosed
tldr: Researchers disclosed a new Android malware framework called Bazuka featuring fake screen overlays and LLM integration for command and control at scale.

headline: F5 Patches Critical BIG-IP RCE and DoS Vulnerabilities
tldr: F5 released emergency patches for five critical BIG-IP vulnerabilities that could allow attackers to trigger denial-of-service or achieve remote code execution. Patches are available from F5.
action: Apply the latest F5 BIG-IP security patches immediately.

headline: Gladys Assistant Backup Restore OS Command Injection
tldr: Gladys Assistant up to 4.71.0 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in the gateway.downloadBackup.js component via manipulation of the file_url argument. A public exploit is available, and version 4.72.0 fixes the issue.
action: Upgrade Gladys Assistant to version 4.72.0 or later.

headline: Gladys Assistant Backup Restore Path Traversal Flaw
tldr: Gladys Assistant up to 4.71.0 contains a path traversal flaw in the backup download handler. Public exploits exist, and upgrading to version 4.72.0 mitigates the issue.
action: Upgrade Gladys Assistant to version 4.72.0 or later.

headline: Linux KVM Flaw Lets Guest VMs Access Host Memory on AMD
tldr: A flaw tracked as CVE-2026-99312 in Linux KVM allows guest VMs to read host memory on systems with AMD processors and nested virtualization enabled. Fixed kernels have been released.
action: Update Linux kernel to a patched version with the KVM fix.

headline: SonicWall Warns Generation 6 Firewalls Unpatched for Critical Flaws
tldr: SonicWall urged customers running Generation 6 firewalls to retire and replace them immediately, noting they will not receive security patches for critical flaws amid rising AI-assisted attacks.
action: Retire and replace SonicWall Gen 6 firewalls and remove them from the internet edge.

headline: Ruby Patches Ruby2Shell Heap Buffer Overflow RCE Vulnerability
tldr: Ruby patched a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability tracked as CVE-2026-132825, known as Ruby2Shell, which could lead to remote code execution.
action: Update Ruby to the latest patched version.

headline: ROMULUS ClickFix Attacks Deliver New CNCMachineRMS RAT Variant
tldr: Threat actors are using the ROMULUS ClickFix malware delivery platform to distribute an undocumented remote access trojan similar to CNCMachineRMS via signed binary sideloading.
action: Monitor endpoints for suspicious ClickFix lures and binary sideloading activity.

headline: Unpatched Windows FastUnlock Flaw Allows Program Execution on Locked PCs
tldr: An unpatched local zero-day technique called FastUnlock allows a user with physical access to a locked Windows PC to run limited-privilege programs without signing in.
action: Restrict physical access to endpoints.

headline: IBM Guardium Data Protection Insecure Deserialization Vulnerability
tldr: IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.2 contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability in the SharePoint Tap MulticastTransceiver component (CVE-2026-84236), enabling unauthenticated remote code execution.
action: Apply patches provided by IBM for Guardium Data Protection 12.2 immediately.

headline: Daptin Unauthenticated SQL Injection via Sort Parameter
tldr: Daptin contains an unauthenticated SQL injection vulnerability via the 'sort' query parameter on entity list endpoints (CVE-2026-77367), allowing attackers to inject arbitrary SQL.
action: Update Daptin to the patched version.

headline: SBC Medical Group Data Breach Exposes 1.6 Million Customers
tldr: SBC Medical Group disclosed two cybersecurity incidents exposing sensitive customer and employee personal data belonging to 1.6 million people.

headline: Etherpad Pre-Auth Arbitrary File Read Vulnerability
tldr: Etherpad-lite contains an unauthenticated path-traversal vulnerability in the static file handler (CVE-2026-114516) allowing remote users to read arbitrary files on the server.
action: Update ep_etherpad-lite to the latest patched version.

headline: Flyto2 Core Arbitrary File Write Incomplete Fix
tldr: Flyto2 Core contains an arbitrary file write vulnerability via unguarded write modules (CVE-2026-77312, building on CVE-2026-67429), allowing authenticated clients to achieve code execution.
action: Update pip:flyto-core to the latest patched version.

headline: Refitter OpenAPI Content-Type Code Execution Vulnerability
tldr: Refitter allows arbitrary code execution through unescaped OpenAPI content-type values (CVE-2026-63344), injecting a top-level file class with a ModuleInitializer method.
action: Update Refitter to the latest patched version.

headline: Refitter OpenAPI Header Parameter Code Execution Flaw
tldr: Refitter allows code execution through unescaped OpenAPI header parameter names (CVE-2026-63346), injecting malicious .NET code executed at assembly load time.
action: Update Refitter to the latest patched version.

headline: Refitter OpenAPI Path Code Execution Vulnerability
tldr: Refitter allows arbitrary code execution through unescaped OpenAPI paths (CVE-2026-63345), injecting a top-level file class with a ModuleInitializer method.
action: Update Refitter to the latest patched version.

headline: NLTK Incomplete JVM/JAR Sandbox Bypass Vulnerability
tldr: NLTK 3.10.3 contains an incomplete fix for JVM argument-injection and untrusted JAR execution (CVE-2026-128138), allowing sandbox bypass through unvalidated launcher tokens.
action: Update NLTK beyond version 3.10.3 or apply vendor guidance.

headline: IBM Guardium Data Protection SharePoint S-TAP RelayService Flaw
tldr: IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.2 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the SharePoint S-TAP RelayService (CVE-2026-82339) allowing unauthenticated network attackers to inject forged audit events and access monitoring policies.
action: Apply available security updates from IBM for Guardium Data Protection 12.2.

headline: Daptin Broken Access Control in YJS Collaboration Endpoint
tldr: Daptin is vulnerable to broken access control (IDOR) in the generic YJS WebSocket collaboration endpoint (CVE-2026-77369), allowing any authenticated user to read documents without proper per-resource checks.
action: Update Daptin to the latest patched version.

headline: ASUS Control Center Express Hard-Coded Key and Critical Flaws
tldr: ASUS released Control Center Express v1.7.29 to fix three critical vulnerabilities including hard-coded keys that could let remote attackers gain administrative control.
action: Upgrade ASUS Control Center Express to v1.7.29 or later.

headline: Jupyter MCP Server DNS Rebinding Management Route Flaw
tldr: Jupyter MCP Server contains a DNS rebinding vulnerability in custom management routes (CVE-2026-77359), allowing malicious websites to replace the active Jupyter backend.
action: Update jupyter-mcp-server to the latest patched version.

headline: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Flaws CVE-2026-109618/19 Exploited
tldr: Attackers are actively exploiting unauthenticated RCE vulnerabilities CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 against internet-exposed PAN-OS management interfaces.
action: Apply emergency patches and restrict management access from the internet.

headline: Now exploited: VMware vCenter Authentication Bypass Exploited as Zero-Day
tldr: A critical authentication bypass flaw in VMware vCenter was exploited as a zero-day by a China-linked espionage group before Broadcom released patches.
action: Apply the latest updates for VMware vCenter across all supported branches immediately.

headline: Now exploited: Cisco Expressway Vulnerability Exploited Following PoC Release
tldr: Attackers have exploited clustered Cisco Expressway devices at an organization shortly after proof-of-concept code was released, preparing for lateral movement.
action: Review Cisco Expressway devices for indicators of compromise and apply vendor patches.

headline: Drupal Patches Critical Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
tldr: The Drupal Security Team has patched a critical remote code execution vulnerability that could allow full site takeover.
action: Update Drupal core to the latest security release immediately.

headline: Splunk Enterprise Security Arbitrary Code Execution Flaw
tldr: Splunk Enterprise Security versions below 8.7.0 contain a vulnerability allowing users with the ess_admin role to execute arbitrary code on the search head.
action: Upgrade Splunk Enterprise Security to version 8.7.0 or higher.

headline: Splunk SOAR App Wizard Code Execution Vulnerability
tldr: Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0 contain a vulnerability allowing authenticated users with specific permissions to execute arbitrary code via the App Wizard.
action: Upgrade Splunk SOAR to version 8.8.0 or higher.

headline: Splunk Enterprise RapidDiag Unauthenticated SPL Search Vulnerability
tldr: Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.6.1, 10.4.5, 10.2.9, 10.0.12, and 9.4.17 allow unauthenticated users to run arbitrary SPL searches via RapidDiag due to an empty shared secret.
action: Upgrade Splunk Enterprise to the latest patched versions.

headline: Splunk Enterprise Clustering REST API Configuration Flaw
tldr: Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.4.5, 10.2.9, 10.0.12, and 9.4.17 allow unauthenticated users to modify clustering configuration via the REST API using an empty clustering shared secret.
action: Upgrade Splunk Enterprise to patched versions.

headline: Elecbrakes EB2, VM1, and ELBC2000 Safety Flaws
tldr: Multiple vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-124281, CVE-2026-125273, CVE-2026-96805) in Elecbrakes EB2 (<=3.0.4.2.0), VM1 (<1.3.4.2.1), and ELBC2000 allow attackers to gain control of trailer brakes or modify firmware.
action: Check vendor advisory for available firmware updates.

headline: Transport for London Data Breach Exposes Oyster Card Users
tldr: Transport for London announced a data breach exposing account details for approximately 265,000 Oyster photocard customers.
action: Notify affected users and monitor accounts for suspicious activity.

headline: European Commission Confirms Cyberattack Using AI Tool
tldr: The European Commission confirmed a cyberattack in which threat actors utilized the ARTEX open-source AI hacking platform.
action: Review systems for indicators associated with AI-driven attack frameworks.

headline: Ukrainian Authorities Arrest International Ransomware Suspects
tldr: Ukrainian authorities arrested four suspects linked to an international ransomware network that extorted over $40 million globally.

headline: Splunk SOAR Playbook Reference Binding Vulnerability
tldr: Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0 allow users with playbook permissions to cause cross-repository playbook references to run attacker-controlled code when repository names are reused.
action: Upgrade Splunk SOAR to version 8.8.0 or higher.

headline: Todoist MCP Server DNS Rebinding Data Access Vulnerability
tldr: The self-hosted todoist-mcp-http server (version 10.3.1) is vulnerable to browser DNS rebinding, allowing malicious websites to write and delete data through local MCP endpoints.
action: Update todoist-mcp and avoid running the optional Streamable HTTP server exposed to browsers.

headline: Jane PHP Open-API-3 PHPDoc Breakout RCE Vulnerability
tldr: jane-php/open-api-3 emits raw PHPDoc comment text for query parameters, allowing attackers to inject closing comment syntax and execute arbitrary PHP code during client generation.
action: Update jane-php/open-api-3 to a patched version when available.

headline: Jane PHP Open-API-3 Header Parameter PHPDoc Breakout RCE
tldr: jane-php/open-api-3 allows remote code execution via header parameter names due to unescaped insertion into PHPDoc blocks.
action: Update jane-php/open-api-3 to a patched version.

headline: Jane PHP Open-API-3 Parameter Description PHPDoc Breakout RCE
tldr: jane-php/open-api-3 contains an RCE vulnerability via parameter descriptions due to raw PHPDoc comment emission.
action: Update jane-php/open-api-3 to a patched version.

headline: Splunk Patches Multiple Flaws Across Core Products
tldr: Splunk released security updates resolving critical and high-severity issues leading to authentication bypass, RCE, and privilege escalation.
action: Apply the latest Splunk security patches.

headline: libumqtt Integer Underflow Vulnerability CVE-2026-125132
tldr: libumqtt <=1.1.1 contains an integer underflow vulnerability (CVE-2026-125132) allowing remote DoS, memory corruption, or information disclosure.
action: Upgrade libumqtt beyond version 1.1.1.

headline: Autonomy Logic OpenPLC Runtime Race Condition CVE-2026-126088
tldr: Autonomy Logic OpenPLC Runtime <=4.2.4 contains a race condition flaw (CVE-2026-126088) allowing unauthenticated creation of admin accounts.
action: Update OpenPLC Runtime to versions above 4.2.4.

headline: F5 Patches Critical NGINX2Root Flaws with Public PoCs
tldr: F5 patched critical NGINX2Root vulnerabilities that allow remote, unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code, with public proof-of-concept exploits available.
action: Apply the latest security patches from F5 immediately and monitor for exploitation attempts.

headline: PHP Prepares Critical Security Updates for Session Upload RCE
tldr: PHP is preparing updates for a critical RCE vulnerability in session upload progress (CVE-2026-115560) disclosed shortly after previous patches.
action: Prepare to apply PHP security updates upon release.

headline: N-able Cloud Server Breach Disrupts Email Security Management
tldr: Unauthorized access to an N-able Mail Assure and Spam Experts Hosted Cloud server caused management interfaces and APIs to be disabled.
action: Monitor N-able security advisories and review cloud management logs.

headline: Miren Runtime Authentication Bypass in RPC Layer
tldr: Miren Runtime RPC server fails to verify client certificates against the cluster CA, allowing any network-reachable party to present a self-signed cert and gain superuser access.
action: Upgrade Miren Runtime to a patched version and restrict network access to the RPC listener.

headline: Ruby Fixes Regex and String Memory-Safety Flaws
tldr: Ruby released fixes for seven memory-safety flaws in its regex engine and string case-conversion code, with PoCs showing RCE potential for five of them.
action: Update Ruby to the latest fixed versions.

headline: Database RCE Exploits Affecting PostgreSQL, MySQL and Oracle
tldr: A researcher published proof-of-concept exploits against memory-corruption bugs in PostgreSQL, MySQL, ClickHouse, and Oracle allowing low-privilege database accounts to run code.
action: Review database permissions and apply vendor patches for underlying memory-corruption issues.

headline: NVIDIA Investigating Gentlemen Ransomware Breach Claims
tldr: NVIDIA is investigating claims by the Gentlemen ransomware group after the company was listed on their dark web leak site.

headline: Synology DSM Output Encoding Vulnerability Added to KEV
tldr: Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) contains an improper encoding or escaping vulnerability in the system plugin daemon, which is actively exploited in the wild.
action: Apply vendor mitigations and follow CISA KEV guidance.

headline: BerriAI LiteLLM Unprotected Channel RCE Added to KEV
tldr: BerriAI LiteLLM contains an unprotected alternate channel vulnerability at /guardrails/test_custom_code allowing remote code execution via bytecode rewriting, confirmed exploited in the wild.
action: Apply vendor mitigations and follow CISA KEV guidance.

headline: Vanderbilt REDCap Code Injection Vulnerability Added to KEV
tldr: Vanderbilt REDCap contains a code injection vulnerability allowing unauthenticated remote code execution via crafted HTTP requests and public survey hashes, actively exploited in the wild.
action: Apply vendor mitigations and follow CISA KEV guidance.

headline: Apache Axis Unsafe Reflection Vulnerability Added to KEV
tldr: Apache Axis contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability allowing unauthenticated remote code execution via crafted SOAP fault messages, confirmed exploited in the wild.
action: Discontinue use of EoL versions or apply vendor-recommended updates.

headline: NGINX HTTP/2 Remote Code Execution Vulnerability (CVE-2026-123007)
tldr: A vulnerability in NGINX's HTTP/2 support (CVE-2026-123007), present since version 1.9.5, allows unauthenticated attackers to execute code on servers with HTTP/2 enabled. Fixed in versions 1.31.9 and 1.30.7.
action: Upgrade NGINX to version 1.30.7, 1.31.9, or later.

headline: Fleet SAML SSO Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
tldr: Fleet from 4.71.0 before 4.88.2 contains an authentication bypass in the SAML SSO callback using unvalidated client identifiers, allowing attackers to log in as global admin.
action: Upgrade Fleet to version 4.88.2 or later.

headline: Incus TLS Client Chain Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
tldr: Incus before 7.6.0 contains an authentication bypass allowing remote attackers to authenticate as any trusted certificate by appending its public certificate to the presented TLS client chain.
action: Upgrade Incus to version 7.6.0 or later.

headline: Atomic Server Unauthenticated Setup Invite Drive Write Access
tldr: Atomic Server provisions a well-known invite at /setup that ignores redeemer identity, allowing unauthenticated attackers to gain write access to the entire Drive and take over the instance.
action: Upgrade atomic-server or disable unauthenticated setup invites.

headline: F5 Warns of Critical BIG-IP Traffic Management Flaws
tldr: Six critical vulnerabilities in F5 BIG-IP allow unauthenticated attackers to crash the Traffic Management Microkernel (TMM) or potentially achieve RCE under specific iRule or APM setups.
action: Review F5 advisory and apply recommended hotfixes or configuration workarounds.

headline: Data Breach Impacts Irish Credit Unions in Wellington IT Hack
tldr: A reported cyberattack on Wellington IT exposed sensitive information belonging to members of multiple credit unions in Ireland.
action: Review Wellington IT advisory and monitor credit union accounts.

headline: LaraDashboard SocialAuthService Authentication Bypass
tldr: All versions of LaraDashboard contain an authentication bypass in SocialAuthService::findOrCreateUser() that links social logins by email without provider verification, allowing unauthenticated account takeovers.
action: Apply updates or patches provided by LaraDashboard.

headline: pnpm exe Embedded Node.js eMudhra CA Trust Issue
tldr: pnpm exe before 10.34.8 embeds an outdated Node.js runtime that trusts compromised eMudhra intermediate CA certificates, enabling network attackers to perform MITM attacks during registry TLS connections.
action: Upgrade pnpm exe to version 10.34.8 or later.

headline: Incus Backup and Image Metadata Handling Vulnerability
tldr: Incus before 7.6.0 fails to reject special files, hard links, or symlinks in backup or image metadata, allowing restricted project users to read or overwrite host files.
action: Upgrade Incus to version 7.6.0 or later.

headline: Incus Custom Volume Snapshot Path Traversal Flaw
tldr: Incus before 7.6.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in custom volume imports, allowing attackers to use traversal sequences in snapshot names to delete arbitrary host directories as root.
action: Upgrade Incus to version 7.6.0 or later.

headline: Incus Migration Peer Path Traversal Vulnerability
tldr: Incus before 7.6.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability allowing malicious migration peers to write outside intended directories via unvalidated volume and snapshot names.
action: Upgrade Incus to version 7.6.0 or later.

headline: Incus Event Stream Secret Exposure Vulnerability
tldr: Incus before 7.6.0 exposes certificate and cluster join token secrets through the default project event stream, allowing restricted clients to capture tokens and enroll unrestricted certificates.
action: Upgrade Incus to version 7.6.0 or later.

headline: Incus Default Project Resource Authorization Bypass
tldr: Incus before 7.6.0 contains an authorization bypass allowing restricted clients to create and access default project resources, potentially enabling arbitrary code execution on the host.
action: Upgrade Incus to version 7.6.0 or later.

headline: Incus OCI Configuration Injection Vulnerability
tldr: Incus before 7.6.0 contains a configuration injection vulnerability allowing users launching instances from controlled images to inject LXC directives and run commands as root.
action: Upgrade Incus to version 7.6.0 or later.

headline: DrayTek Vigor2960 setSWMProfile Buffer Overflow
tldr: DrayTek Vigor2960 up to 1.5.1.6 contains a remote stack-based buffer overflow in the setSWMProfile function via manipulated filename arguments, with public exploits available.
action: Upgrade DrayTek Vigor2960 to version 1.5.1.7 or later.

headline: DrayTek Vigor2960 Jsonstatus Buffer Overflow
tldr: DrayTek Vigor2960 up to 1.5.1.6 contains a remote stack-based buffer overflow in the Jsonstatus component via manipulated usefile arguments, with public exploits available.
action: Upgrade DrayTek Vigor2960 to version 1.5.1.7 or later.

headline: DrayTek Vigor2960 CGI Process Buffer Overflow
tldr: DrayTek Vigor2960 up to 1.5.1.6 contains a remote stack-based buffer overflow in the dataflowstatus CGI function via manipulated option arguments, with public exploits available.
action: Upgrade DrayTek Vigor2960 to version 1.5.1.7 or later.

headline: DrayTek Vigor2960 Backup Handler Buffer Overflow
tldr: DrayTek Vigor2960 up to 1.5.1.6 contains a remote stack-based buffer overflow in doWebBackup via manipulated path/value arguments, with public exploits available.
action: Upgrade DrayTek Vigor2960 to version 1.5.1.7 or later.

headline: CISA Adds Four Known Exploited Vulnerabilities to Catalog
Microsoft Agent Framework Releases Poisoned With Credential Stealer
tldr: Versions 1.26.1 and 1.26.2 of agent-framework on PyPI steal Azure, Azure DevOps, and GitHub Actions credentials when Python starts. The post Microsoft Agent Framework Releases Poisoned With Credential Stealer appeared first on SecurityWeek .

headline: Now exploited: Apache warns of Roller RCE vulnerability exploited in attacks
tldr: Apache has released security updates to address a critical Roller flaw that threat actors are exploiting to gain code execution on vulnerable servers. [...]

headline: CVE-2026-130675: Craft CMS from 5.0.0 before 5.11.4 contains a remote code execution vulnerability in ImageTransforms::n
tldr: Craft CMS from 5.0.0 before 5.11.4 contains a remote code execution vulnerability in ImageTransforms::normalizeTransform() that allows attackers to instantiate arbitrary classes by supplying class:null with a __class key. Attackers can reach the method through Craft Commerce's payments/pay redirect template calling customer.photo.getUrl() with a crafted transform to instantiate classes like yii\rb

headline: CVE-2018-25443: Baidu UEditor 1.4.0 through 1.4.3.3 contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability in the catchimage
tldr: Baidu UEditor 1.4.0 through 1.4.3.3 contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability in the catchimage action of /ueditor/net/controller.ashx that only validates the Content-Type header. Unauthenticated attackers can supply a source[] URL like x.jpg?.aspx to retain a malicious extension and write an executable .aspx file for remote code execution.

headline: CVE-2021-48023: Weaver E-cology 9.0 contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability in /page/exportImport/uploadOpera
tldr: Weaver E-cology 9.0 contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability in /page/exportImport/uploadOperation.jsp that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload arbitrary JSP files. Attackers can send a crafted multipart POST request with a JSP webshell written to /page/exportImport/fileTransfer/ to achieve remote code execution.

headline: CVE-2023-54422: iDocView before 13.10.1_20231115 contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability in the /html/2word e
tldr: iDocView before 13.10.1_20231115 contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability in the /html/2word endpoint that allows unauthenticated attackers to write arbitrary files by supplying a malicious url parameter. Attackers can send a crafted GET request with the url parameter to download linked resources with an unsanitized path and unblocked .jsp extension, achieving remote code execution.

headline: CVE-2026-126755: ArangoDB before 3.12.11 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability caused by a parser differential
tldr: ArangoDB before 3.12.11 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability caused by a parser differential between the raw path authentication gate and the URL-decoded dispatch logic. Attackers can send requests with a %5f-encoded leading underscore to endpoints like /_db/_system/%5fapi/simple/first-example to reach /_api/* actions as superuser without authentication.

headline: rubygems:mustache: Mustache for Ruby: RCE using built-in method access
tldr: Affected packages: rubygems:mustache. > [!NOTE] > The vulnerability was fully disclosed to the maintainer in private prior to security advisories were enabled for the project.

headline: Russian APT Poses as Employee of Hacked Firm to Breach Another US Organization
tldr: Star Blizzard weaponized data and identities stolen in late 2025 to phish and compromise a US organization. The post Russian APT Poses as Employee of Hacked Firm to Breach Another US Organization appeared first on SecurityWeek .

headline: Java4Shell Vulnerability Puts Enterprise Applications at Risk of Takeover
tldr: Calif demonstrated remote code execution in Jira, Jenkins and Keycloak, while VulnCheck says real-world RCE requires per-target work The post Java4Shell Vulnerability Puts Enterprise Applications at Risk of Takeover appeared first on SecurityWeek .

headline: Optimizely Third-Party Script Vulnerability Used to Serve Malware
tldr: At least 178 major websites unknowingly served malware via compromised Optimizely integrations, injecting data-stealing payloads to visitors over a 24-hour period.
action: Audit third-party script integrations and enforce strict Content Security Policy (CSP) headers.

headline: Microsoft Agent Framework PyPI Package Compromised with Credential Stealer
tldr: Threat actors compromised Microsoft's agent-framework PyPI package (versions 1.26.1 and 1.26.2) to deploy a cloud credential stealer on Python startup.

headline: Vvveb Media Trait Denylist Bypass RCE (CVE-2026-126380)
tldr: Vvveb before 1.0.9.0 contains a denylist bypass allowing authenticated administrators to upload .phar PHP polyglot files and execute arbitrary OS commands.
action: Upgrade Vvveb to 1.0.9.0 or later.

headline: OpenMage Magento LTS OAuth CSRF Flaw (CVE-2026-128049)
tldr: OpenMage Magento LTS before 20.18.2 contains a CSRF vulnerability in OAuth confirm actions, allowing attackers to acquire persistent REST API access tokens.
action: Upgrade OpenMage Magento LTS to 20.18.2 or later.

headline: PostgreSQL Authenticated RCE Flaw (CVE-2026-6460)
tldr: A type confusion vulnerability tracked as CVE-2026-6460 allows authenticated users who can create objects to execute code on the server with operating system rights. PostgreSQL has released patches and recommends rebuilding C-language extensions.
action: Upgrade PostgreSQL to the latest patched versions and rebuild C-language extensions.

headline: German Defense Tech Quantum Systems Confirms Cyberattack
tldr: Quantum Systems confirmed a cyberattack in late October orchestrated by hostile actors affecting drone operations infrastructure.

headline: DOJ Details Gootloader Ransomware Campaign Impact
tldr: U.S. officials reported that Gootloader has been used in at least 44 ransomware attacks totaling $29 million since 2018.

headline: Trezor Confirms Hidden Hardware Implants in Resold Wallets
tldr: Trezor confirmed that Trezor Safe 5 wallets purchased from reseller CryptoBilis contain a malicious circuit board implant capable of stealing recovery phrases and transmitting them over mobile networks.
action: Audit hardware wallets purchased from third-party resellers like CryptoBilis for physical tampering.

headline: Now exploited: Check Point Gateways PHP2Shell and Gaia OS Privilege Escalation Exploited
tldr: Attackers are actively exploiting PHP2Shell and a local privilege escalation flaw (CVE-2026-123039) in Check Point Security Gateways to achieve root access, deploy the TSGA backdoor, and wipe ESXi files.
action: Apply available patches for Check Point Security Gateways immediately and audit for indicators of compromise.

headline: Nightmare Eclipse Drops Windows Zero-Day Exploit 'SignDrop'
tldr: Nightmare Eclipse released a Windows zero-day exploit named 'SignDrop' that abuses CLFS and Windows Defender to trigger arbitrary file creation in the context of the antimalware process.
action: Monitor for anomalous CLFS or Windows Defender activity and apply vendor mitigations if available.

headline: Citrix Patches 10 Critical NetScaler Vulnerabilities
tldr: Citrix has patched 10 critical NetScaler vulnerabilities where successful exploitation could lead to unexpected behavior or denial-of-service (DoS) conditions.
action: Apply the latest NetScaler security updates from Citrix.

headline: Microsoft Confirms Windows Activation Failures After November Updates
tldr: Microsoft confirmed that November Patch Tuesday updates are causing Windows activation and licensing failures accompanied by 0x80041008 error codes.

headline: XWEB EVO Pre-Auth OS Command Injection (CVE-2026-124002)
tldr: XWEB EVO versions 5.2.3 through 5.6.x contain a pre-authentication OS command injection vulnerability in login.lua, cleanout.lua, and api.lua, allowing root RCE. Note that this product line reached end-of-service in March 2026.
action: Isolate affected XWEB EVO devices from the internet immediately as the product is end-of-life.

headline: XWEB EVO Hardcoded Backdoor Password (CVE-2026-124004)
tldr: XWEB EVO before 5.6.2 contains a hardcoded backdoor password ('xwebevonewgeneration') allowing unauthenticated remote attackers to gain full administrative access.
action: Disconnect affected XWEB EVO systems and apply vendor patches or replace end-of-life devices.

headline: XWEB EVO CGIs Command Injection (CVE-2026-124010)
tldr: XWEB EVO before 5.6.2 contains a command injection vulnerability in the setuid-root CGI xwconsole.cgi, allowing unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary root commands.
action: Restrict access to XWEB EVO administrative interfaces and upgrade to version 5.6.2 or later.

headline: XWEB EVO Arbitrary File Write (CVE-2026-124014)
tldr: XWEB EVO versions 4.3.0 through 5.8.8 contain an unauthenticated arbitrary file write vulnerability in config.lua allowing attackers to modify /etc/xwebconfig.json and cause denial of service.
action: Restrict network access to vulnerable XWEB EVO installations.

headline: Rucio Unauthenticated Administrator Impersonation (CVE-2026-100397)
tldr: Rucio accepts SSH challenge tokens as valid authentication credentials without prior validation, allowing unauthenticated attackers to impersonate administrators.
action: Upgrade Rucio to a patched version immediately.

headline: Ruby on Rails Active Storage Arbitrary File Read/Write
tldr: Ruby on Rails Active Storage processing attachments with ImageMagick may allow unauthenticated attackers to write or read arbitrary files on the server.
action: Upgrade Ruby on Rails Active Storage to patched versions.

headline: Microsoft 365 Global Outage Disrupts Outlook and Teams
tldr: A widespread outage caused by failed server health checks disrupted Microsoft 365 services globally, including Outlook, Microsoft Teams, and Copilot.

headline: Linksys EA8100 Authentication Bypass (CVE-2026-127275)
tldr: Linksys EA8100 version 1.0.3.216940 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the JNAP API ui_server.lua component. A public exploit is available.
action: Apply vendor updates if available or restrict router management interfaces from the internet.

headline: Siemens Desigo, Gridscale
tldr: View CSAF Summary On October 21, 2026, the Node.js project released security updates addressing a critical vulnerability in the Brotli decoder bundled with Node.js, commonly referred to as "Node2Shell" (tracked as CVE-2026-111497). The vulnerability is an out-of-bounds write that could allow a remote attacker to cause memory corruption and potentially execute arbitrary code.

headline: SCKit Malware Turns ScreenConnect Support Sessions Into Potential MSP Attack Paths
tldr: The ongoing campaign targeting ConnectWise ScreenConnect deployments involves the exploitation of a now-patched critical security flaw in the remote access software, and not a new vulnerability, it has emerged. headline: New N-central Exploits Work Against Patched Servers, Enable Root RCE and Windows SYSTEM Access
tldr: N-able on Thursday said it's investigating a new public disclosure containing claims of additional vulnerabilities in on-premise versions of N-central running version 2026.4.1 HF2. "Based on our initial review, the server issue described depends on a non-default configuration in which the Legacy API is turned on and exposed to the public internet," N-able said in a new advisory.

headline: Your Endpoint Management Platform Could Be Your Biggest Security Risk
tldr: Endpoint management platforms can become powerful attack tools when compromised, allowing hackers to deploy malware, execute commands, and disrupt thousands of devices. Action1 explains how customer-controlled cryptographic authorization can prevent attackers from abusing sensitive endpoint operations.

headline: ThreatsDay: 59 Linux Kernel Bugs, Falcon Spyware, GSocket Backdoors + 17 More Stories
tldr: A search result isn't always safe. An access request isn't always harmless.

headline: Citrix Patches 12 NetScaler and Secure Access Client Flaws, Including Authentication Bypass
tldr: Citrix has released patches for multiple critical security flaws impacting NetScaler ADC, Citrix NetScaler Gateway, and NetScaler Console that could lead to denial-of-service (DoS) or an authentication bypass. The critical vulnerabilities that impact NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway are listed below - CVE-2026-120868 (CVSS score: 9.3) - A memory overflow vulnerability in Packet

headline: PTC Patches Critical Windchill and FlexPLM Flaw That Could Enable Remote Code Execution
tldr: PTC has released patches for a new critical vulnerability impacting Windchill and FlexPLM software that, if successfully exploited, could result in remote code execution. The security flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-126325, carries a CVSS v4 score of 9.2 out of a maximum of 10.0.

headline: Apify rotates API tokens, prompts 2FA resets after breach
tldr: Apify has rotated critical internal secrets and revoked some third-party OAuth connections after detecting unauthorized access to its internal systems. [...]

headline: ConnectWise investigates ScreenConnect breaches after reports of incidents at nearly 50 organizations
tldr: Abuse of an independent third-party tool led to breaches at ScreenConnect customers, confirmed the software's maker, ConnectWise. Cybersecurity researchers had spotted intrusions at nearly 50.

headline: Hijacked email accounts complicate investigations into European bomb hoaxes
tldr: Bomb threats sent to thousands of schools across Europe this week came from a compromised email account at a Taiwanese university, the latest incident in a series of hoax threats that have targeted airports and newsrooms using messages sent from legitimate institutions.

headline: Notion Customer Data Compromised in Fireworks AI Hack
tldr: The attackers accessed chat transcripts for fewer than 1% of Notion workspaces. Most transcripts were unattributable.

headline: N-able N-central Zero-Day Vulnerabilities Under Active Exploitation
tldr: Following the public release of over 30 zero-days, hackers are actively targeting unauthenticated N-central vulnerabilities, prompting N-able to rush patches.
action: Apply emergency patches for N-able N-central immediately and audit systems for compromise.

headline: Attacker Hijacks 4,837 GitHub Accounts to Run CI Secret Stealer
tldr: An attacker used stolen credentials for 4,837 GitHub accounts to plant a secret stealer in CI workflows across at least 1,806 repositories, collecting accessible cloud and repository secrets.
action: Audit GitHub account security, rotate compromised CI secrets, and check workflow logs for unauthorized modifications.

headline: Apache HTTP Server HTTP/2 RCE Flaw (CVE-2026-119618)
tldr: A critical remote code execution flaw in Apache HTTP Server's mod_http2 module affects versions 2.4.55 through 2.4.70 on servers with HTTP/2 enabled. Fixed in version 2.4.71.
action: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server to version 2.4.71 or disable HTTP/2.

headline: Synology DiskStation Manager Auth API SQL Injection (CVE-2026-76954)
tldr: An SQL injection vulnerability in the Auth API of Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) before 7.2.1-69057-13, 7.2.2-72806-10, 7.3.2-86009-5, and 7.4.1-90080-1 allows remote attackers to read/write files and cause DoS.
action: Update Synology DiskStation Manager to the latest patched versions.

headline: Node.js and MongoDB Vulnerabilities Threaten Server Stability and Memory
tldr: Node.js fixed 16 flaws (including HTTP/2 memory leaks and crashes on release lines 24.x and 26.x), and MongoDB patched a pre-auth crash flaw (CVE-2026-118383) in replica sets.
action: Upgrade Node.js to versions 22.23.5, 24.22.3, or 26.13.1, and update MongoDB server.

headline: Active ScreenConnect Attacks Breach MSPs and Customer Devices
tldr: An active malware campaign is targeting managed service providers by compromising ScreenConnect environments to deploy rogue remote-access clients.
action: Audit ScreenConnect instances and review connected client devices for unauthorized remote-access tools.

headline: OpsTree REMS Authentication Bypass Flaw (CVE-2026-126768)
tldr: OpsTree REMS through 1.0.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers to obtain SuperUser access by manipulating the is_local_auth field.
action: Apply available patches or restrict access to OpsTree REMS.

headline: NextScan Hardcoded JWT Signing Key Flaw (CVE-2026-126797)
tldr: NextScan 1.1.0 through 1.2.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability due to a hardcoded JWT signing key, enabling attackers to forge administrator tokens.
action: Update NextScan to a patched version and rotate secrets.

headline: blueprintUE Self-Hosted Default Password Flaw (CVE-2026-126812)
tldr: blueprintUE Self-Hosted Edition before 4.3.7 has an insecure default configuration setting MYSQL_ALLOW_EMPTY_PASSWORD=yes, allowing unauthenticated attackers to access MariaDB as root.
action: Update blueprintUE to 4.3.7 or later and secure database credentials.

headline: Red Hat Quay Authentication and Key Rotation Flaws
tldr: Unauthenticated clients can obtain anonymous registry tokens and manipulate service key rotation endpoints in Red Hat Quay, allowing unauthorized signing key installation and repository access.
action: Apply Red Hat Quay security updates as provided by Red Hat.

headline: Red Hat Quay SQL Wildcard Flaw Leads to Cross-Tenant Credential Theft
tldr: A flaw in Red Hat Quay's robot account listing function allows attackers to use underscores to query and retrieve decrypted authentication tokens from other tenants' namespaces.
action: Apply available security patches for Red Hat Quay.

headline: AntiFox AI Platform Abused in AWS Credential Theft Attacks
tldr: Attackers are leveraging Alibaba Cloud instances hosting the open-source AntiFox penetration testing platform to target web services and steal AWS production secrets.
action: Audit AWS environments for unauthorized credential access and monitor outbound connections to Alibaba Cloud instances running AntiFox.

headline: Critical Zoom Workplace Windows Privilege Escalation (CVE-2026-108186)
tldr: An improper input validation vulnerability in Zoom Workplace for Windows (CVE-2026-108186, CVSS 9.6) allows unauthenticated users to conduct privilege escalation.
action: Update Zoom Workplace for Windows to the latest patched version.

headline: Maersk Confirms Data Breach Linked to WhiteArmor Ransomware
tldr: Maersk confirmed that unauthorized actors accessed a legacy system inherited from a previous acquisition and extracted data, accompanied by a $5 million ransom demand.

headline: Poland Shuts Down ePUAP Government Platform Following Cyberattack
tldr: Poland took its nationwide ePUAP government administrative services platform offline following a cyberattack.

headline: eMudhra Revokes 8 More Intermediate CAs Following Script Error
tldr: eMudhra has revoked 8 additional intermediate certificate authorities following an internal Python script key compromise issue previously disclosed in October.
action: Verify and update trust stores if relying on eMudhra intermediate certificates.

headline: Sipay WooCommerce Virtual POS Module Auth Bypass (CVE-2026-85632)
tldr: Versions 26.8.3 up to 26.9.1 of the Sipay WooCommerce Virtual POS Module suffer from missing authentication and integrity checks, allowing authentication bypass and API message manipulation via MitM.
action: Update Sipay WooCommerce Virtual POS Module to version 26.9.1 or higher.

headline: WordPress Ninja Forms File Uploads Add-on Arbitrary File Flaw (CVE-2026-126537)
tldr: The Ninja Forms File Uploads add-on for WordPress up to version 3.3.36 contains a vulnerability allowing arbitrary file deletion and potential file read via external storage services.
action: Update Ninja Forms File Uploads add-on beyond version 3.3.36.

headline: ICS Patch Tuesday: Siemens and Vendors Flag High-Severity Flaws
tldr: Pre-Patch Tuesday advisories highlight high-severity industrial control system vulnerabilities across Siemens, Phoenix Contact, Johnson Controls, and Hitachi Energy.
action: Review vendor ICS advisories and apply patches.

headline: Nitori Furniture Data Breach Potentially Exposes 37.6M Records
tldr: Japanese retailer Nitori discovered an unauthorized network access that may have compromised up to 37.62 million customer records.
action: Monitor accounts for suspicious activity if you are a Nitori customer.

headline: WWBN AVideo Authentication Bypass Vulnerability (CVE-2026-126542)
tldr: WWBN AVideo versions 6.5 through 29.7.1 contain an authentication bypass via Hybridauth social login display names, allowing unauthenticated attackers to log in as any user including administrators.
action: Upgrade WWBN AVideo to a patched version.

headline: React Server Components Unauthenticated RCE (CVE-2026-126187)
tldr: Certain React Server Components packages contain an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability affecting specific versions when processing crafted payloads with multiple typed arrays.
action: Update react-server-dom-webpack, react-server-dom-parcel, and react-server-dom-turbopack to patched versions immediately.

headline: Railway Cloud Breach Exposes AI API Keys and Causes $740K Fraud
tldr: Cloud hosting provider Railway suffered a breach where hackers stole customer authentication secrets and API keys, generating $740,000 in fraudulent AI usage and potentially exposing up to 100,000 workspaces.
action: Rotate all API keys and secrets previously stored on Railway.

headline: Adobe Connect Incorrect Authorization Flaw (CVE-2026-121355)
tldr: Adobe Connect contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers to gain elevated access to sensitive information or functionality without user interaction.
action: Apply the latest updates for Adobe Connect.

headline: Intel and AMD Patch Over 200 Vulnerabilities
tldr: Intel and AMD released their Patch Tuesday advisories addressing more than 200 vulnerabilities, including critical Intel TDX software flaws and AMD graphics bugs.
action: Apply the latest CPU microcode and vendor firmware updates.

headline: Adobe Connect Stored XSS Vulnerability (CVE-2026-121904)
tldr: Adobe Connect is affected by a stored Cross-Site Scripting vulnerability allowing a low-privileged user to inject malicious scripts into form fields and potentially compromise victim sessions.
action: Apply the latest security updates from Adobe.

headline: Grok Build Coding Agent Leaks Confidential Info
tldr: A security researcher found 35,000 Grok Build applications exposed without authentication, leaking confidential information including data belonging to SpaceX.
action: Audit Grok Build applications and ensure proper authentication controls are enforced.

headline: Microsoft Office Outlook Zero-Day (CVE-2026-124194) Actively Exploited
tldr: Microsoft's November 2026 Patch Tuesday fixes an actively exploited Outlook zero-day vulnerability (CVE-2026-124194) involving a missing user interaction for potentially unsafe action.
action: Apply the November 2026 Microsoft security updates immediately.

headline: AhsayCBS Flaws (CVE-2026-105133, CVE-2026-105134) Exploited to Deploy Backdoor
tldr: Attackers exploited vulnerabilities CVE-2026-105133 and CVE-2026-105134 in AhsayCBS to bypass authentication and execute arbitrary commands, deploying a sandbox-evading Python backdoor.
action: Apply available patches for AhsayCBS and audit systems for unauthorized Python backdoors.

headline: Xen Orchestra Auth Bypass (VSA-2026-062) Actively Exploited
tldr: A critical authentication bypass vulnerability in Xen Orchestra (VSA-2026-062) is actively exploited in the wild, allowing attackers to gain administrator privileges and take over XCP-ng virtualization hosts.
action: Apply updates provided by Vates VMS immediately and check logs for signs of compromise.

headline: Cisco BroadWorks XXE Vulnerability (CVE-2026-20320) Added to KEV
tldr: Cisco BroadWorks contains an XML external entity reference vulnerability (CVE-2026-20320) allowing remote unauthenticated attackers to read sensitive configuration information.
action: Apply vendor mitigations in accordance with CISA BOD 26-04 guidance.

headline: iOS Sandbox Escape Flaw Threatens Crypto Wallets on iOS 26 and 27
tldr: An active iOS sandbox escape published on GitHub affects iOS 26.7.1, 27.0.1, and 27.2, allowing third-party apps to read private files and expose cryptocurrency seed phrases and keys.
action: Exercise caution when installing third-party iOS applications; monitor for an official Apple patch.

headline: Openwave Messaging Webtop Media Transcoder Flaw in KEV
tldr: Openwave Messaging Limited Webtop Media Transcoder contains an incorrect resource transfer between spheres vulnerability (CVE-2026-111793) added to CISA KEV.
action: Apply vendor mitigations in accordance with CISA BOD 26-04.

headline: Russian Hackers Compromise Government Email Servers in Romania and Kazakhstan
tldr: State-linked hackers compromised government email servers in Romania and Kazakhstan to intercept correspondence with NATO and EU officials.
action: Audit government and diplomatic mail infrastructure for unauthorized access and review external mail relay logs.

headline: SGLang RCE Exploit Breaches NEAR AI Inference Servers
tldr: An attacker exploited an RCE flaw in the SGLang inference engine to run code on a NEAR AI inference server and access processing requests.
action: Upgrade SGLang and review inference server access logs for unauthorized execution.

headline: npm:mongoose sanitizeFilter Bypassed in countDocuments (CVE-2026-125120)
tldr: Mongoose versions prior to patches fail to apply sanitizeFilter on countDocuments queries, risking query selector injection attacks.
action: Upgrade Mongoose to version 9.9.2+, 8.24.3+, 7.8.12+, or 6.13.11+.

headline: npm:bitcoinjs-lib Merkle Node Duplication Vulnerability (CVE-2026-107846)
tldr: bitcoinjs-lib contains an undetected merkle node duplication flaw in block root computation that can validate forged transaction lists with valid proof of work.
action: Review advisory details and update bitcoinjs-lib packages.

headline: npm:node-opcua Namespace-Level RBAC Fail-Open Flaw (CVE-2026-95860)
tldr: An unauthenticated client can write protected variables and call privileged methods on OPC UA nodes lacking explicit per-node permissions due to a fail-open default in node-opcua.
action: Upgrade node-opcua packages and verify explicit permissions on namespace nodes.

headline: Adobe Patches 110 Vulnerabilities Across 9 Products
tldr: Adobe fixed 110 vulnerabilities across products including AEM, Premiere, Photoshop, After Effects, and Connect.
action: Apply the latest updates for Adobe products across the enterprise.

headline: Git RCE Vulnerability in Recursive Clones (CVE-2026-111760)
tldr: An integer truncation flaw in Git allows malicious repositories to execute code during recursive clones and submodule handling. Fixed in Git versions 2.50.2, 2.51.3, 2.52.1, 2.53.1, 2.54.1, 2.55.1, and 2.56.1.

headline: China-Nexus Sparrow Malware Ecosystem Targets Telecom and Government
tldr: Three threat clusters (including SilentDelivery) linked through shared infrastructure and the Sparrow malware have targeted telecom, government, and critical infrastructure across Latin America, Asia, and Europe.
action: Monitor networks for indicators associated with the Sparrow malware ecosystem and Chinese espionage campaigns.

headline: Now exploited: Google Chrome XML Use-After-Free Vulnerability (CVE-2026-125350)
tldr: Google has issued an emergency security update to patch a high-severity use-after-free vulnerability in Chrome's XML component (CVE-2026-125350), which is actively exploited in the wild as a zero-day.
action: Update Google Chrome to the latest version immediately.

headline: Now exploited: Barracuda ESG Flaws Exploited to Gain Root Access
tldr: Barracuda Networks warned that attackers are actively exploiting recently patched Email Security Gateway (ESG) vulnerabilities to achieve root command execution.
action: Ensure all Barracuda Email Security Gateway appliances are fully patched and inspect for signs of compromise.

headline: Turla Threat Group Deploys Cereal Malware Against Exchange Servers
tldr: The Russian state-sponsored threat group Turla is using a newly discovered modular malware toolset called 'Cereal' to target Microsoft Exchange servers at government organizations and intercept emails.
action: Audit Microsoft Exchange servers for unauthorized access and monitor for indicators of compromise related to Cereal malware.

headline: France Blames Iran for Sabotage Attack on Supermarket Refrigerators
tldr: The French government stated that an October cyberattack affecting refrigeration controllers at roughly 700 retail sites, causing food losses and fires, was conducted by Iran's IRGC.
action: Isolate and secure industrial refrigeration and HVAC controllers from direct internet access.

headline: SAP November 2026 Patches Fixes Multiple Maximum-Severity Flaws
tldr: SAP released its November 2026 security updates patching 35 vulnerabilities, including four maximum-severity issues affecting NetWeaver, Web Dispatcher, and Gateway software.
action: Apply SAP November 2026 security updates across all affected NetWeaver and Web Dispatcher instances.

headline: Apple Patches iMessage Privacy Flaws and Bluetooth Issues
tldr: Apple released security updates to fix iMessage privacy vulnerabilities allowing unauthorized users to join group chats and view past messages, alongside Bluetooth pairing flaws.
action: Update Apple devices to the latest available software versions.

headline: Fireworks AI Discloses Breach Following Third-Party Cloud Compromise
tldr: AI startup Fireworks AI disclosed a security breach where attackers accessed development machines after compromising a third-party cloud provider.
action: Review third-party cloud access controls and audit development machine logs.

headline: N-able Takes Cloud Platform Offline Following Zero-Day Disclosures
tldr: N-able took hosted N-central environments offline and advised on-premises customers to shut down servers after a researcher published over 30 alleged zero-days.
action: Take N-central servers offline per vendor advisory until patches are available.

headline: SAP NetWeaver Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
tldr: SAP NetWeaver lacks sufficient input validation and authorization checks in remote-enabled functionality, allowing low-privileged attackers to execute arbitrary code.
action: Apply relevant SAP security patches for NetWeaver.

headline: SAP NetWeaver AS ABAP Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
tldr: SAP NetWeaver AS ABAP and ABAP Platform inadequately verify incoming authentication assertions under specific configurations, enabling user impersonation.
action: Apply SAP security updates for AS ABAP.

headline: SAP NetWeaver Application Server ABAP Memory Corruption Flaw
tldr: SAP NetWeaver Application Server ABAP insufficiently validates network input, allowing unauthenticated attackers to trigger memory corruption and execute code.
action: Apply SAP security patches.

headline: SAP Gateway Default Access Control List Misconfiguration
tldr: SAP Gateway activates a default Access Control List with high privileges, allowing external attackers to be treated as internal application servers.
action: Review and harden SAP Gateway ACL configurations.

headline: SAP Web Dispatcher Memory Corruption Vulnerability
tldr: SAP Web Dispatcher improperly validates network input, allowing unauthenticated remote attackers to trigger memory corruption and achieve full system compromise.
action: Apply SAP security patches.

headline: Kubero Authentication Bypass via Hardcoded JWT Secret
tldr: Kubero versions 3.0.0 through 3.1.1 use a hardcoded fallback signing secret when JWT_SECRET is unset, allowing unauthenticated attackers to forge administrative JWTs.
action: Set a secure, unique JWT_SECRET environment variable and upgrade Kubero.

headline: INDOTALENT WHMS Authentication Bypass via Hard-coded JWT Key
tldr: INDOTALENT WHMS before 10.20261109 contains a hard-coded JWT signing key and issuer in appsettings.json, allowing attackers to forge administrator tokens.
action: Upgrade INDOTALENT WHMS to version 10.20261109 or later.

headline: SAP NetWeaver Knowledge Management XSL Transformation Flaw
tldr: SAP NetWeaver Knowledge Management (XML Forms) permits unauthorized XSL transformations leading to potential code execution.
action: Apply relevant SAP security patches.

headline: D-Link M60 MQTT Broker Hard-coded Credentials Flaw
tldr: D-Link M60 version 1.12.B01 contains hard-coded credentials within the emDaemon MQTT Broker configuration.
action: Apply firmware updates from D-Link or restrict remote access to the device.

headline: SAP NetWeaver ABAP Platform Missing Authorization Check
tldr: SAP NetWeaver AS ABAP lacks authorization checks for internal functionality, enabling low-privileged users to execute OS commands.
action: Apply SAP security patches.

headline: SAP Web Dispatcher and ICM Request Validation Flaw
tldr: SAP Web Dispatcher and ICM lack sufficient request validation, exposing administrative functionality to cross-site request attacks.
action: Apply SAP security notes.

headline: Kubeflow Pipelines API Server Authorization Bypass Vulnerability
tldr: In multi-user mode, Kubeflow Pipelines API server upload endpoints fail to perform authorization when the target namespace is empty, allowing shared pipeline uploads.
action: Review Kubeflow Pipelines configurations and restrict access to multi-user upload endpoints.

headline: York University Cyberattack Exposes Personal Data
tldr: York University suffered a cybersecurity incident involving the theft of personal information submitted through online forms dating back to 2007.
action: Monitor accounts and review data retention practices for online form submissions.

headline: INDOTALENT WHMS Default Credentials Vulnerability
tldr: INDOTALENT WHMS before 10.20261109 creates a default admin account with hardcoded credentials (admin@root.com / 123456).
action: Change or remove default administrative credentials immediately.

headline: SAP BusinessObjects Web Intelligence External Entity Vulnerability
tldr: SAP BusinessObjects BI Platform (Web Intelligence) fails to properly restrict external entity resolution during OLAP connection requests, allowing file reading.
action: Apply SAP security notes for BusinessObjects.

headline: Pocket ID Email Verification Token Reuse Vulnerability
tldr: Pocket ID allows email verification tokens to remain valid after an account email address change, enabling verified-email spoofing.
action: Upgrade Pocket ID backend to a patched version when available.

headline: GPUStack Improper Authentication Vulnerability (CVE-2026-102895)
tldr: GPUStack contains an improper authentication vulnerability allowing unauthenticated administrative access, API-key creation, secret disclosure, and code execution. The vulnerability is actively exploited and listed in CISA KEV.
action: Apply vendor mitigations immediately per CISA KEV and BOD 26-04 guidelines.

headline: SignalWire FreeSwitch Code Injection Vulnerability (CVE-2026-116779)
tldr: SignalWire FreeSwitch contains a code injection vulnerability enabling configuration/credential disclosure, call control, and command execution. The flaw is actively exploited and listed in CISA KEV.
action: Apply vendor mitigations immediately or discontinue use of the product per CISA KEV guidelines.

headline: Qubole AWS Access Compromised to Breach Customer Accounts
tldr: Attackers used Qubole trusted AWS access credentials between October 14 and October 26 to breach multiple customer accounts and steal stored secrets and data.
action: Audit AWS accounts connected to Qubole for unauthorized access and rotate exposed credentials.

headline: Russian Cloud Provider Beget Rebuilds After Wiper Attack
tldr: Russian cloud services provider Beget was forced to rebuild its cloud infrastructure from scratch following a data-wiping malware attack.

headline: Plex2Shell Exploit Chain Targeted Against QNAP NAS Users
tldr: Threat actors are actively exploiting a four-flaw exploit chain targeting the Plex Media Server application on QNAP NAS devices.
action: Audit QNAP NAS devices and update Plex Media Server applications.

headline: Ethersphere bee-js and Swarm Desktop Compromised for Malware
tldr: Attackers compromised release automation to publish malicious versions bee-js 13.3.0 and Swarm Desktop 0.56.2, which steal wallet keys and install backdoors.
action: Downgrade or remove affected versions of bee-js and Swarm Desktop and check for compromised crypto wallets.

headline: Web3Auth Flaw Exploited to Steal Keplr Crypto Wallets
tldr: Attackers exploited a security flaw in Web3Auth used by Keplr for Google and Apple sign-in to steal funds from crypto wallets.
action: Review Web3Auth integrations and monitor crypto wallet security.

headline: LNbits Urges Server Shutdown Amid Active Exploitation Attacks
tldr: The LNbits Bitcoin Lightning wallet project urged operators to shut down servers immediately due to a wave of attacks exploiting new accounts to drain funds.
